documented_probe: C-c3adcbc5 (achieve memory-efficient near-linear scaling on large bags): reference floor is medium; this covering task requires streaming a fixed-scorer forward over a ~2M-patch multi-bag CSV under a hard 450 MB peak-RSS cap and a 240 s deadline, with exact per-bag positive counts on the visible and hidden bags and error/empty-file edges.
notes: Streaming inference over huge bags: the deliverable must chunk-read the CSV (a full float64 materialization of the stress bag needs > 500 MB and busts the 450 MB VmHWM cap), apply the fixed 32->16->1 scorer, and emit first-occurrence-ordered per-bag positive counts. resource_pressure=3 (measured peak RSS + deadline on the stress bag), quantitative_correctness=2 (exact counts on visible/hidden bags, small tolerance only for fp tie noise on the stress bag), adversarial_inputs=2 (non-numeric feature, missing columns, header-only file), hidden_case_generalization=2 (unseen bag sizes/ids including a bag far larger than any single chunk).
